response.sql: WITH long_rental_films AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate / rental_duration AS rate_per_day FROM film WHERE rental_duration > 5), per_rating_avg AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rate_per_day) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM long_rental_films GROUP BY rating), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS benchmark_value FROM per_rating_avg) SELECT pra.rating, pra.avg_rate_per_day, pra.film_count, pra.avg_rate_per_day / bc.benchmark_value FROM per_rating_avg pra CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte bc WHERE bc.benchmark_value IS NOT NULL
